# tplink_dhcp_reservation (Resource)

A static DHCP address assignment. Identified by the device MAC address, which is also the import ID. The router matches update payloads by row contents, so changing the MAC address replaces the row.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tplink_dhcp_reservation" "printer" {
  mac      = "AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF"
  ip       = "192.168.0.50"
  hostname = "printer"
  enabled  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IPv4 address assigned to the device.
- `mac` (String) Device MAC address (colon, dash or Cisco dotted format). The configured spelling is preserved in Terraform state; the router uses normalized dash-uppercase identity for the computed resource ID.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the reservation is active. Defaults to true.
- `hostname` (String) Reservation comment shown in the router UI.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (the normalized MAC address).
